about_blocks.text: Field Trip Health Toronto: Revolutionizing Mental Health Treatment
about_blocks.html: Field Trip Health Toronto: Revolutionizing Mental Health Treatment

about_blocks.text: Field Trip Health Toronto is a forward-thinking mental health clinic that offers medication-assisted therapy (MAT) to individuals struggling with severe depression, anxiety, and PTSD. With a team of experienced medical and mental health experts, the clinic provides the highest quality of care by using evidence-based treatments to address the underlying causes of mental illness.
about_blocks.html: Field Trip Health Toronto is a forward-thinking mental health clinic that offers medication-assisted therapy (MAT) to individuals struggling with severe depression, anxiety, and PTSD. With a team of experienced medical and mental health experts, the clinic provides the highest quality of care by using evidence-based treatments to address the underlying causes of mental illness.

about_blocks.text: MAT is a revolutionary approach to treating mental health disorders that involves using medications that work in conjunction with therapy to alleviate symptoms. Field Trip Health Toronto uses ketamine-assisted therapy, a form of MAT that has been shown to be highly effective in treating treatment-resistant depression and anxiety. The therapy involves administering a low dose of ketamine to the patient, which stimulates the growth of new neural connections in the brain. The patient is then guided through a talk therapy session that helps them process their emotions and develop coping strategies.

about_blocks.text: At Field Trip Health Toronto, each patient receives a personalized treatment plan tailored to their unique needs and preferences. The clinic’s highly trained therapists work with patients to identify their goals and develop an individualized therapy plan that works for them. The clinic uses a variety of evidence-based therapies, including cognitive behavioral therapy, somatic experience, and dance movement therapy, to help patients achieve long-term wellness.

centre.faq_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Field Trip Health Toronto

faqs.question: How long does a typical ketamine-assisted therapy session last?

answer_blocks.text: Each session typically lasts around 2-3 hours.
answer_blocks.html: Each session typically lasts around 2-3 hours.

faqs.question: Is ketamine-assisted therapy covered by insurance?

answer_blocks.text: While most insurance plans do not cover ketamine-assisted therapy, Field Trip Health Toronto does offer financing options and accepts FSA and HSA payments.
answer_blocks.html: While most insurance plans do not cover ketamine-assisted therapy, Field Trip Health Toronto does offer financing options and accepts FSA and HSA payments.

faqs.question: Can I continue taking my current medication while undergoing therapy at Field Trip Health Toronto?

answer_blocks.text: It is important to consult with your medical provider before discontinuing any medication. However, many patients are able to reduce or stop taking medication after starting ketamine-assisted therapy.
answer_blocks.html: It is important to consult with your medical provider before discontinuing any medication. However, many patients are able to reduce or stop taking medication after starting ketamine-assisted therapy.

faqs.question: Do I have to live in the Toronto area to receive treatment at Field Trip Health Toronto?

answer_blocks.text: No, Field Trip Health has several locations across North America and plans to expand globally.
answer_blocks.html: No, Field Trip Health has several locations across North America and plans to expand globally.

faqs.question: Are there any side effects of ketamine-assisted therapy?

answer_blocks.text: Common side effects include mild dissociation, dizziness, and nausea, which typically subside within a few hours after the therapy session.
